```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
setwd(here::here())
```

```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(IPDfromKM)
library(survival)
library(SurvdigitizeR)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```

```{r}
res <- survival_digitize(
  img_path       = here::here("test", "plot-220.png"),  
  num_curves     = 2,                               
  attempt_OCR    = FALSE,                        
  bg_lightness   = 0.3,                   
  x_start        = 0,
  x_end          = 60,
  x_increment    = 10,
  y_start        = 0,
  y_end          = 1,
  y_increment    = 0.1,
  y_text_vertical = FALSE,           
  nr_neighbors   = 20,
  enhance        = FALSE,
  impute_size    = 0,
  line_censoring = FALSE
)

digitized <- res
head(digitized)
```
